children: has purchased Swedish AI startup Stilla.ai to help in the development of Meta Business Agent, which facilitates transactions on WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram.
Stilla, which was founded in 2024, will bring its team members and technology to Meta at the close of the deal, according to an  Axios report on Wednesday.
Stilla raised $5 million in pre-seed funding in January.
Still didn't immediately respond to Axios request for comment.
